description: This file is a Java source code defining the 'Beta' utility class within the org.apache.commons.math3.special package. It provides methods for computing the regularized beta function, log beta function, and related numerical algorithms, referencing advanced mathematical techniques and external scientific literature.

classes.name: Beta
classes.description: Utility class providing numerical methods for the Beta family of functions, including the regularized beta function and log beta function, implemented with advanced algorithms and mathematical references.

methods.name: regularizedBeta
methods.description: Computes the regularized incomplete beta function I(x, a, b) using continued fractions and transformations for numerical stability.

methods.name: logBeta
methods.description: Calculates the natural logarithm of the beta function B(a, b) with algorithms that vary based on the parameter ranges for accuracy and efficiency.
